SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-04-2019 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF HUENING, THOMAS RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT YELDA, BELLES Y. $8,539.00 PRINCIPAL, $155.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $8,694.00, PLAINTIFF SHALL RETURN THE 1988 ITASKA MOTOR HOME TO DEFENDANT AND DEFENDANT SHALL ACCEPT THAT RETURN. IN THE EVENT DEFENDANT REFUSES THE RETURN OR DOES NOT ACCEPT WITHIN 60 (SIXTY) DAYS OF THIS JUDGMENT PLAINTIFF MAY DISPOSE OF THE ITASKA IN ANY WAY AND RETAIN THE PROCEEDS IN ADDITION TO THE AMOUNT OF THE JUDGMENT.
